claims.claim: The committed software vector regenerates exactly and is accepted by pure-Python P-256 math, cryptography 45.0.7, and OpenSSL 3.5.6.
The restricted verifier rejects all preregistered Stage 0 encoding, DER, malleability, schema, and binding negative classes represented by the committed fixtures and tests.
Changing any tested domain or binding field changes the digest and invalidates the original signature.
The canonicalizer is a complete general-number RFC 8785 implementation.
The authority path, service isolation, key custody, PIV interoperability, concurrency, crash safety, or production readiness is established.
